// A position on a planet's surface: geodetic latitude, longitude, and altitude
// above the reference ellipsoid
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geographic_coordinate_system).
type GeoCoordinate
    implements IValue
{
    Latitude: Angle;
    Longitude: Angle;
    Altitude: Length;
}
